SELECT D.DEPT_ID AS deptId, D.DEPT_CD AS deptCd, D.DEPT_NM AS deptNm, D.UPPER_ID AS upperId, P.DEPT_NM AS upperNm, D.MNGR_ID AS mngrId, M.USER_NM AS mngrNm, D.SORT_ORDR AS sortOrdr, D.DEPT_DESC AS deptDesc, D.USE_AT AS useAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_USER U WHERE U.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD) AS userCnt FROM OPS_DEPT D LEFT JOIN OPS_DEPT P ON P.DEPT_ID = D.UPPER_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_USER M ON M.USER_ID = D.MNGR_ID WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY D.SORT_ORDR, D.DEPT_ID OFFSET #{firstIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{recordCountPerPage} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_DEPT D WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT D.DEPT_ID AS deptId, D.DEPT_CD AS deptCd, D.DEPT_NM AS deptNm, D.UPPER_ID AS upperId, P.DEPT_NM AS upperNm, D.MNGR_ID AS mngrId, M.USER_NM AS mngrNm, D.SORT_ORDR AS sortOrdr, D.DEPT_DESC AS deptDesc, D.USE_AT AS useAt, TO_CHAR(D.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS regDt FROM OPS_DEPT D LEFT JOIN OPS_DEPT P ON P.DEPT_ID = D.UPPER_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_USER M ON M.USER_ID = D.MNGR_ID WHERE D.DEPT_ID = #{deptId}
SELECT DEPT_ID AS deptId, DEPT_CD AS deptCd, DEPT_NM AS deptNm FROM OPS_DEPT WHERE USE_AT = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORDR, DEPT_ID
SELECT DEPT_CD FROM OPS_DEPT WHERE DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_DEPT (DEPT_CD, DEPT_NM, UPPER_ID, MNGR_ID, SORT_ORDR, DEPT_DESC, USE_AT, REG_DT) VALUES (#{deptCd}, #{deptNm}, #{upperId}, #{mngrId}, #{sortOrdr}1, #{deptDesc}, #{useAt}'Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE OPS_DEPT SET DEPT_CD = #{deptCd}, DEPT_NM = #{deptNm}, UPPER_ID = #{upperId}, MNGR_ID = #{mngrId}, SORT_ORDR = #{sortOrdr}, DEPT_DESC = #{deptDesc}, USE_AT = #{useAt} WHERE DEPT_ID = #{deptId}
